description: CONDITIONAL bound on Erdős minimum overlap constant µ ASSUMING the optimal f* is even (f(x)=f(-x)). The modified SDP enforces d_k=0 (sin Fourier coeffs vanish), dlt_k=0 (sin tail = 0) and v_j=w_j (cell averages match on positive and negative sides) for all k,j.
interpretation: If the (open) conjecture that f* is even holds, then µ ≥ MIN over rows. If the modified SDP gives MIN > 0.379005 + ε, then either µ > White's bound (under conjecture) OR the conjecture is false — both publishable.
note_h1: For even f, h_1 := L^2 Σ((j)w_j - (j-1)v_j) reduces to L^2 Σ w_j = L/2 = 1/N → 0 as N→∞. White Table-3 rows with h>0 are therefore INFEASIBLE under the even assumption (recorded as 'infeasible'). The MIN is taken over feasible rows only, i.e. row5 and row6, which lie on the h=0, q=0 axis.
anti_bluff_caveats: This is a CONDITIONAL bound. We are NOT claiming µ ≥ 0.379751 unconditionally.
The result µ ≥ 0.379751 holds IFF the optimal f* is even.
Status 'optimal_inaccurate' from CLARABEL — rerun with higher precision or different solver to certify rigorously.
Bochner level capped at n=25 due to CLARABEL convergence; n=30 fails.

rows.reason: h>0 forces ∫ x f(x) dx ≠ 0 which contradicts f even

summary.improvement_over_non_conditional_bochner: ≈ +0.00 (essentially same; min is dominated by row6 in both)

ellipse_extension_note: The MIN-over-Table3 argument requires the union of ellipses centered at the 7 rows to cover the (h,p,q) space accessible to admissible f. Under the even assumption that space collapses to the (p,0,0) axis, which is covered by row5 (p=0.4) and row6 (p=0.381). However, the same ellipse-extension question that affects White's full bound applies HERE TOO: do the row5 and row6 ellipses jointly cover the full p-range of even-admissible f? If not, additional p-axis rows must be added (this would be cheap, only along the p-axis).
